harvestIndicators: Leave ears on the stalk until they are fully mature and dry

sprayWindows.title: PRE residual at planting (Group 15)
sprayWindows.body: Apply a Group 15 residual herbicide (acetochlor, dimethenamid, S-metolachlor or pyroxasulfone) to the soil after planting and before the corn emerges. Rain or irrigation activates it.

sprayWindows.title: PRE atrazine at planting
sprayWindows.body: Atrazine goes on preemergence, after planting and before the corn emerges. Follow the atrazine use restrictions on the label.

sprayWindows.title: POST atrazine, four to five weeks after planting
sprayWindows.body: Control weeds that came up with the crop four to five weeks after planting. Apply atrazine before weeds are 1.5 inches tall and before corn reaches 12 inches.

sprayWindows.title: POST mesotrione, four to five weeks after planting
sprayWindows.body: Control weeds that came up with the crop four to five weeks after planting. Mesotrione (Callisto) goes on postemergence to corn up to 30 inches tall (8-leaf stage).
